heldout-phase.limitation: Quiet phase at the pulse markers is counterfactual; grid differences and inversion error remain.
heldout-phase.question: Does the locked fourth-order prediction improve a new local clock history?
heldout-phase.reading: Held-out finest trace error: second 0.1882%, fourth 0.1712%.
heldout-phase.significance: A separate waveform tests the coefficient after the inspected-history diagnostic.

marker-reconstruction.limitation: The coarse vacuum control is post-hoc; Hermite cannot repair spatial dispersion or WKB error.
marker-reconstruction.question: Do derivative-informed markers and twice-frequent output explain local timing error?
marker-reconstruction.reading: On h=.025, compare markers at 0.05 and decimated 0.1; coarse vacuum/known-Z maximum errors are 0.05998/0.05981.
marker-reconstruction.significance: Separates temporal interpolation from surface-propagation error.

prior-diagnostic.limitation: The prior histories and marker times were already inspected; this is not a prospective prediction.
prior-diagnostic.question: Does the derived fourth-order coefficient explain the inspected residual sign and scaling?
prior-diagnostic.reading: Compare the saved Test 7 amplitude ladder at the same nominal A=.004 marker times.
prior-diagnostic.significance: This diagnoses the missing order independently of a fitted coefficient.
